title.hint: Hot seat: every player takes turns on this screen. Rules: docs/trial-rules.md.
pause.title: Paused
gameover.title: Game over
hint.roll: Roll the dice to start your turn. Click a cell to see it.
hint.none: Choose an action, or click a cell to see it.
hint.move: Click one of your cells to move a troop from it.
hint.move-target: Click a neighboring cell (1 troop per click). Click the source again to drop it.
hint.wagon-group-target: Choose how many troops, then click a neighboring cell.
hint.wagon-long-target: Click a cell up to 3 steps away.
hint.recruit: Click a cell touching one of your castles.
hint.attack: Click the cell your troops attack from.
hint.attack-target: Click the same cell (attack inside) or a neighboring enemy cell (attack from outside, only from a cell you hold).
hint.build: Click an intersection at the end of the side shared by two neighboring cells you hold.
hint.promote: Click one of your settlements: inner with its 4 cells held → castle; coast with its 2 cells held → port.
hint.conquer: Click an enemy or grey building whose cells you hold (castle 4, port 2, settlement 3 of 4).
trade.title: Port trade
info.title: Cell
log.gold-used: {player} pays {gold} gold for the missing cards
error.invalid-target: That is not a valid target.
error.not-neighbor: It must be a neighboring cell or intersection.
error.not-enough-troops: You do not have enough troops there.
error.cannot-pay: You cannot pay for it, even with your gold.
error.no-castle: That cell does not touch one of your castles.
error.no-defender: There are no enemy troops there.
error.not-held: You can only attack from outside from a cell with only your troops.
error.point-taken: There is already a building there.
error.need-two-held: You need two neighboring cells you hold that meet there.
error.cannot-promote-corner: A settlement on a board corner cannot be promoted.
error.need-all-held: You must hold every cell it touches.
error.conquer-condition: You do not hold enough of its cells.
error.pick-your-troops: Pick a cell with your troops.
